answer: Defection bounties turn every fake key into a witness against its own farm. Rewards wait at the jetty, a 72-hour holding queue, before release. During that wait anyone may submit a pigment: one message signed by two queued keys over the same fresh nonce, which proves one operator holds both. Both keys are banned and their queued rewards go to the submitter as the pearl. A farm of 100 keys exposes 4,950 pairs, and any insider who copies two keys can sell one pigment for both payouts; self-reporting only returns the farm's own money while still burning both keys.
